question: On the m=8 PKM Kummer-chain system over prime fields, how does the complete charged work c(B) of one positive sparse solver invocation scale with B=2^t, and is the measured exponent gamma below the gates 3.5 (all-output) and 3 (one-output)?

claims.text: Cell derivation, target classification (real and algebraic decompositions), solver-output verification and useful-relation rank are exact computations.
The per-call work exponent gamma between B=4 and B=8 (lower bound from B=16) lies above or below 3.5.
The projected whole-attack exponent E_all(gamma) of the Lean cost-floor model and its distance to 1/2.

arms.description: msolve 0.6.5 mode param (-t 8 -v 2 -P 1), all F4 passes and parametrization charged; mode gb (-g 2) only for the t=2 cross-check
crypto_lib f4_fp grevlex single thread; second instrument for the exporter (reduced-basis equality vs mode gb) at t=2 SAT1/UNSAT1; never carries gamma
native negation-map rho on each cell's hidden instance, 3 seeds; reference row only

cells.p_rule: L1 decisive cell p=16801793 with its curve, g, zeta if recoverable, else the rule
least eligible prime >= 2^28 with 16 | p-1; censor probe; only if a t=3 natural row completed

targets_per_cell.classifier: exhaustive signed multisets of 8 real base points; algebraic count over F_{p^2} recorded

caps.memory_enforcement: RSS watchdog 2 s poll; prlimit --as at 1.25 x cap as backstop; VmHWM/VmPeak recorded at stop

positive.expected: planted decomposition among extracted real decompositions when the call completes
positive.failure_means: instrument fault; the cell's SAT rows are invalid

aa.comparison: t2r7 SAT target 1 run first and last of the t=2 block
aa.expected: work_proxy identical; rho_AA = max/min cpu_s recorded

second_instrument.comparison: reduced basis equality native f4 vs msolve -g 2 at t=2 SAT1/UNSAT1

replication.comparison: t3r8 on the L1 curve vs committed A3 log round structure

exporter_variety_size.expected: msolve count >= native ordered algebraic count; every native real decomposition recovered

canary.what: fixed-work mode-gb L1-curve run, timeout 120, before each t=3 call; drift > 1.5x flags the row

variable_ledger.factor: instrument (commit, binary sha256, msolve package+hash, flags, threads)
host (one RunPod pod; lscpu, RAM recorded)
variable_ledger.treatment: measured; shared by all rows; co-tenancy uncontrolled (L0)
fixed; A/A first and last of the t=2 block

seeds.derivation: StdRng seeded by master xor sha256(cell slug); hidden k and (a_j,b_j) from a separate seeded stream sealed in hidden.json

blinding.note: SAT/UNSAT labels are public for stratification only; the solver pipeline never reads hidden.json; the analyst reads runs.jsonl only after done.json

primary_metrics.name: cpu_s
primary_metrics.unit: CPU seconds (user+sys of msolve mode param incl. all passes + verify); second reading adds base construction and target mask

primary_metrics.name: work_proxy
primary_metrics.unit: sum over F4 rounds of rows x cols x density

decision_rule.gamma_lo: log2(min_j c_lo(8,j) / max_j c(4,j)); min over all t=3 natural rows (censored = lower bound); max over ALL natural t=2 rows; undefined (KILL unavailable) if any natural t=2 row did not complete
decision_rule.gamma_hi: log2(max_j c(8,j)/min_j c(4,j)); +inf unless a t=3 natural param row completed
decision_rule.gamma_lo_8_16: log2(c_lo(16)/max_j c(8,j)) if the probe ran; undefined if any t=3 natural row is censored
decision_rule.reachability: KILL needs min c_lo(8) >= 11.3 x max c(4); pilot seed 777 timings in PILOT.md; 256 GB pod required, no fallback
decision_rule.KILL_scoped: gamma_lo(4->8) >= 3.5 on cpu_s and work_proxy, exporter gates + t=2 planted/negative + A/A + canaries passing; scope = msolve 0.6.5 -t 8 -P 1 pipeline on the raw Kummer-chain presentation, m=8, B in {4,8}; does not close the PKM lead, other presentations, solvers, arities or larger B
decision_rule.NOT_KILLED_at_B_le_8: gamma_hi + log2(rho_AA) < 3.5 on cpu_s and gamma_hi < 3.5 on proxy, both cost readings, completed param runs and verified natural positives at t=3, every t=2 natural row completed; reported as INCONCLUSIVE with direction; ADVANCE impossible
decision_rule.censoring: cap-stopped call = lower bound on c(B); may support KILL, never NOT_KILLED; a censored control is not evaluable
decision_rule.secant_note: gamma(4->8) is a local secant over one doubling of B containing the degree step; never extrapolated

tables: per-call rows (cell, target, label, solver, cpu_s, wall_s, max_rss, censored, work_proxy, max_round_degree, useful_relations, rank_increment)
per-cell summary (median, min, max, censored count) per observable
gamma table (4->8, 8->16 lower bound) per observable

budget.route: RunPod CPU pod (isolab monthly budget exhausted: 1808.95 of 1300 USD on 2026-11-14)
budget.flavor: cpu5m 32 vCPU / 256 GB required; no smaller fallback
budget.section_5a: msolve cpu is unpriced; no cross-method ranking; rho rows only for the exponent comparison

promoting any row to a leaderboard without the validation gate

eligibility.g_rule: least g>=2 outside mu_{2^t} with B_real >= B/2
eligibility.crash_rule: rc 139 with max RSS < 50% of cap or within 60 s = crash; cell replaced by next eligible prime before any natural row is analysed

plan_order: t=2 block (planted first per cell; A/A t2r8 SAT1 first and last; gb+native for SAT1/UNSAT1 inside); t=3 natural interleaved t3r8-UNSAT1,t3r7-SAT1,t3r9-UNSAT1,t3r8-SAT1,t3r7-UNSAT1,t3r9-SAT1, then remaining natural round-robin, canary before each; t=3 planted last; t4r7 probe conditional

generation_accounting.attack_setup: base construction (field ops, square tests) and target mask
